name: Purchase Requisition Status
query:
SELECT
            mr.name as "Requisition:Link/Material Request:150",
            mr.transaction_date as "Date:Date:100",
            mr.owner as "Requester:Link/User:150",
            mr.requesting_department as "Requesting Department:Link/Department:150",
            mr.concerned_department as "Concerned Department:Link/Department:150",
            mr.workflow_state as "Approval Stage:Data:180",
            mr.material_request_type as "Type:Data:100",
            SUM(mri.qty) as "Total Qty:Float:100",
            SUM(mri.amount) as "Estimated Value:Currency:130"
        FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
        LEFT JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mri ON mri.parent = mr.name
        WHERE mr.docstatus != 2
        GROUP BY mr.name
        ORDER BY mr.creation DESC

name: Items Below Reorder Level
query:
SELECT
            ir.parent as "Item:Link/Item:150",
            i.item_name as "Item Name:Data:200",
            ir.warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
            COALESCE(b.actual_qty, 0) as "Current Stock:Float:120",
            COALESCE(b.projected_qty, 0) as "Projected Qty:Float:120",
            ir.warehouse_reorder_level as "Reorder Level:Float:120",
            ir.warehouse_reorder_qty as "Suggested Reorder Qty:Float:150"
        FROM `tabItem Reorder` ir
        JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = ir.parent
        LEFT JOIN `tabBin` b ON b.item_code = ir.parent AND b.warehouse = ir.warehouse
        WHERE i.disabled = 0
        AND ir.warehouse_reorder_level > 0
        AND COALESCE(b.projected_qty, 0) <= ir.warehouse_reorder_level
        ORDER BY ir.parent

name: Physical Count Variance
query:
SELECT
            sr.name as "Reconciliation:Link/Stock Reconciliation:150",
            sr.posting_date as "Date:Date:100",
            sri.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:150",
            sri.warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
            sri.current_qty as "System Qty:Float:100",
            sri.qty as "Counted Qty:Float:100",
            sri.quantity_difference as "Qty Variance:Float:100",
            sri.amount_difference as "Value Variance:Currency:120"
        FROM `tabStock Reconciliation` sr
        JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri ON sri.parent = sr.name
        WHERE sr.docstatus = 1
        AND sri.quantity_difference != 0
        ORDER BY sr.posting_date DESC
